title: SparseMatter - Next Generation Voxel Engine
author: intelligence-dev
selftext: This is a very early test of SparseMatter's rendering implementation for animated entities. The visual style is not final. I purposely chose a cute chibby style to test but I will experiment with what fits best here. I wanted to avoid the "puppet" look. I did not want a model composed of multiple body parts and animated the traditional way. The "skin" of the entities should look "as expected" within the constraints of the voxel world. Essentially, can we simulate a 3D sprite? I think I have achieved it. However, the toughest work is ahead. Will it scale? How much memory is required? Etc. This is far from finished, but I am really pleased with the results so far. The real showcase is the brontosaurus towards the later half of the video which depicts the intent here. The pop-in will be fixed. This is just a test.
